questions.stem: Nitrogen gas (N2) contains a triple bond. How many electrons are shared between the two nitrogen atoms?
questions.explanation: A triple bond consists of three shared pairs of electrons. Each pair contains 2 electrons, so a triple bond involves 6 shared electrons (3 pairs x 2 electrons = 6). Each nitrogen needs 3 more electrons for a full outer shell, which is why they share 3 pairs.
